units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:3">R. Hash. III, 3</cite> <he>של יעל פ׳</he> a straight horn of the mountain-goat, opp. <he>כפוף</he>.

<cite ref="Menachot 35b:5">Men. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ אחא מחוי פ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="A03283"><he>אשי</he></cite>) R. A. showed the index finger straight, i.e. the strap must reach from the arm to the tip of the index finger, when straightened, opp. <he>כפוף</he> (v. Tosaf. a. l.; Rashi: the strap must be as long as the distance from the thumb to the index finger, stretched as wide as possible, opp. <he>כפוף</he> the distance from the index to the middle finger). Mekh. B’shall. beg. <he>לא הביאן הק״בה דרך פ׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord did not lead them on the direct road to Palestine; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 226:9">Yalk. Ex. 226</cite> <he>בפשוטה</he> (sub. <he>דרך</he>). Mekh. l. c. <he>לא הביאן המקום בפישוטן</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:16:1">Cant. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>בלשון פ׳</he> with a single expression (of praise), opp. <he>כפול</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:1">B. Bath. X, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>גט פ׳</he> a plain, open document, opp. <he>מקושר</he> folded; Tosef. Gitt. VIII (VI), 9 <he>פ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>גט פ׳</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 3:3:4">Y. R. Hash. III, 58ᵈ</cite> top <he>פשוטה</he> (sub. <cite ref="V00884"><he>תקיעה</he></cite>) the plain note (<cite ref="V00884"><he>תקיעה</he></cite>), opp. the tremulous note; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:14">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין מקרא יוצא מידי פְשׁוּטוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="M02452"><he>מִקְרָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (sub. יורש) an heir entitled to a single share, opp. בְּכוֹר.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 52b:9">Bekh. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>מה חלק פ׳ ירושה וכ׳</he> as the share of the plain heir is an inheritance, so the share of the firstborn is an inheritance (and not a gift affected by the jubilee laws); <cite ref="Bava Batra 124a:5">B. Bath. 124ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 126a:10">Ib. 126ᵃ</cite> <he>בכור … כפ׳ ויתר</he>, v. <cite ref="F00115"><he>וָתַר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:12:2">Y. Keth. IV, end, 29ᵇ</cite> <he>בכור שחלק בפ׳</he> (read <he>בפ׳</he>).
Num. R. s. 6 בני פ׳ the sons of a plain (not firstborn) man; a. fr.—Fem. פְּשׁוּטָה (sub. ירושה) single share.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:3:2">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵇ</cite> top, opp. <cite ref="K01014"><he>כְּפֵילָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>פְּשׁוּטִים</he>, <he>פְּשׁוּטִין</he>; <he>פְּשׁוּטוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 103b:14">Sabb. 103ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>. Num. R. l. c. <he>פְּשׁוּטֵי הלוים וכ׳</he> the plain (not firstborn) Levites took the place of the firstborn Israelites; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 6:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. VI, 1</cite> <he>המשנה … מן הפ׳ לקיבול</he> if one changes a leather implement … from a flat surface to a receptacle.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:3">Ib. IV, 3</cite> <he>פְּשׁוּטוֹ טהור</he> in its flattened condition (when the bag is unrolled), it is not susceptible to uncleanness; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:1">Kel. II, 1</cite> <he>פְּשׁוּטֵיהֶן</he> those of them which are flat, opp. <he>מקבליהן</he> which have receptacles.

<cite ref="Shabbat 123b:4">Sabb. 123ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>פְּשׁוּטֵי כלי עץ</he> flat wooden implements (boards &c.). Y. ib. X, end, 12ᵈ <he>בפ׳</he> when they are flat, opp. <he>מקופלין</he> folded; a. fr.
